fields.description: When unchecked, the A2A server endpoint and Agent Card return 404 — other agents cannot reach or discover Friday.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Other agents reach exactly the skills THIS Agent Profile is allowed to use (role + permission-matrix scoped), and every message/send runs as this profile through the governed agent loop (matrix + audit + approval gate).
fields.label: Exposed Agent Profile

fields.options: Endpoint: POST /api/method/friday.friday_core.a2a.server.handle. Agent Card: GET /.well-known/agent.json (public). Authenticate calls with the X-A2A-Token: <token> header (a custom header, NOT Authorization: Bearer — Frappe's auth layer would reject a Bearer token before the endpoint runs). Speaks A2A JSON-RPC (message/send, tasks/get, tasks/cancel).

fields.description: Static token a calling agent must present in the X-A2A-Token header. Stored encrypted. Generate a long random value and treat it as a credential.
fields.label: A2A Token
